name: Mini Sweet Chili Crunchwraps
desc: Small crunchwraps of taco-seasoned lean beef, tostada, cheese and fresh vegetables, toasted golden and dipped in sweet chili sauce.

source.title: Mini Sweet Chili Heat Crunchwrap Supremes
source.evidence: Saved Instagram reel; caption and on-screen text captured in the owner's saved-recipes export

ingredients.raw: 1/2 cup nacho cheese sauce (or 8 slices cheddar)
1/4 cup Thai sweet chili sauce, for dipping

steps: Brown the beef in a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it up, until no pink remains (160°F). Stir in the taco seasoning and water and simmer until the liquid is absorbed, 3-4 minutes.
Lay out the tortillas. In the center of each, add about 1/4 cup beef, a tostada half, 1 tbsp cheese sauce (or a cheese slice), tomato and lettuce.
Fold the edges of the tortilla in toward the center around the filling, pleating as you go.
Spray a nonstick skillet and heat over medium-low. Toast the crunchwraps seam side down until golden, 2-3 minutes, then flip and toast 2-3 minutes more.
tips: The creator's measured recipe is in her e-book and pinned comment; these amounts are filled from standard crunchwrap proportions.
Put the cheese sauce under the tostada so it glues the layers together.

references.title: Homemade Crunchwrap Supreme
references.usedFor: beef and taco seasoning ratio, build order, medium-low heat and 2-3 min per side
